text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight was in her room, thinking 
over the outfit advice requested by many 
of her friends, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Umm, next up is that girl... It was a 
dress to wear to a casual party, right...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...It's not overly formal... She always 
wears a flower on her chest... Oh dear, 
what color was it again?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: I think the details were in the message...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: My head is... Ugh... Trainer, Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...No. I can't be whining like this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can't concentrate like this... 
And we were having so much fun, too..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
North Flight slumped her shoulders in 
defeat. It seemed she was plagued by a 
headache for a while after...
